# Rules for the published npm package

Last verified against commit: 136615be21009eb2ea72a249527f07e2c1c61ab3

The package is `@crutrade/contracts`. It ships ABIs, per-network addresses and TypeChain types for
eight contracts: `Roles`, `Brands`, `Wrappers`, `Whitelist`, `Payments`, `Sales`, `Memberships`,
`USDCApprovalProxy`.

## Generated files

- `index.ts` is written by `script/update-package.ts`. Its first line says "Auto-generated - Do not edit
  manually". To change its shape, edit the template string inside that script and re-run the build.
- `types/**` is written by TypeChain through `script/generate-types.ts`. Never hand-edit.
- Both are regenerated by `npm run build`, which also runs `forge build --via-ir`, `tsup` and
  `script/create-deployments.ts`.

## Addresses

Addresses in `index.ts` come from `deployments/<network>/latest.json`, which
`script/create-deployments.ts` derives from `broadcast/deploy.s.sol/<chainId>/run-latest.json` by
mapping each implementation to its `ERC1967Proxy`. A contract with no proxy in the broadcast file is
emitted as the zero address; `USDCApprovalProxy` on mainnet is currently zero for that reason.

## Public surface

`index.ts` exports `abis`, `addresses`, `getContract(name, network)` and a default object combining
the three. `package.json` exposes the root entry from `dist/` and a `./types` subpath pointing at
`types/index.ts`. Changing either export map is a breaking change for consumers; bump the version and
record it in `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Broken file

`config.ts` at the repo root imports `./logging/logger`, which does not exist, and resolves artifacts
under `../contracts/out`, a path outside this repository. It is not part of the published package
(`files` lists only `dist`, `deployments`, `types`). Do not import it from new code.

`npx tsc --noEmit` currently fails with four pre-existing errors across three files, and that is the
baseline to compare against: `config.ts:4` (TS2307, the missing logger), `script/init.ts:129` (TS18046
twice), and `script/fetch-wrapper-events.ts:637` (TS2322). Any error beyond these four is new and
yours to fix.
